verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no documented self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core Secureframe product. The 'ingest data from on-prem' claims describe data import into the hosted service, and the MCP server repo is an adjacent integration, not the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
